exact_prompt:
Edit this precise entire game diffuse UV image into a very modest HD hand-painted texture. Reference is the complete native64square stored RGB nearest-enlarged to512square, not an object illustration. Preserve the ENTIREsquarecanvas with exactly the original normalized positions, part widths/heights, contours, dark gaps, paintmarks and pattern scale. No crop, padding, whitespace, frame, fitting, zoom, recentering or layout change.

Keep the subdued charcoal bluegray soft painted metal fields. Preserve the original tall central flat gray field with its thin original source lightedges; the separate left softly shaded horizontal painted field; the separate darker narrow right field; and the original bottom dim darkbrown field with its tiny original amberpaint patches. Keep every weak local patch and dark rectangular source spot at exactly its original position/shape. BlackRGB is original shadowpaint; do not invent any physicalhole, screw, latch, badge, lettering or hardware from these marks. Keep thin original edges thin and faint, not raised rims or new whiteplates.

In native original x0..12,y0..50, the mean painted row-profile has FOURTEEN measured local tonal maxima at y1,3,8,12,16,18,21,24,28,32,34,37,40,44. Preserve these original irregular weak tonal positions as PAINT SHADING, not fourteen physical ribs. Do not impose a regular periodic grid, sharpen them into metalgrooves, change phase or invent new folds. Gently resolve the already present fine subdued mottled painted material only; original mostlyflat areas remain mostlyflat. No added roughgrain, weave, rust, scratch, engraving, crease, brightglint, bevel, extra edge, bolt, text, logo, symbol or decorative curl. Preserve original low contrast and hue hierarchy. Output opaque completeUVcanvas RGB; original alpha restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
